title: Discovery 4 — the pool is ACTIVE and tradeable (no credentials)
description: 500,000 W-tCeBM_CRC against 925,000 W-tCeBM_CLP, one Central Bank on each side. ACTIVE means both sides are seeded; EMPTY means neither is; PENDING_COUNTERPART means one Central Bank has committed and the other has not.
notes: Gateway: any. The pair travels in the URL path here, which is why this kit uses the slash-free pair id: the route is /api/v2/amm/pool/:pair/status, a single path segment. Divergence: the platform document declares 404 for an unavailable pool while the delivered handler answers 422 with error_code POOL_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE; handle whichever you get. pool_status is the one recovered vocabulary published as a real enum, because the gateway derives it exhaustively from the two reserves and gates swaps on it.
